name: PolypGen: Multi-Centre Polyp Detection and Segmentation Benchmark
description: PolypGen is a multi-centre colonoscopy benchmark specifically designed to assess domain generalization for colorectal polyp detection and segmentation. Curated across 6 clinical centres in Norway, France, the United Kingdom, Egypt, and Italy (>300 patients), it contains 8,037 frames: 3,762 positive frames (1,537 still images and 2,225 positive video sequence frames) and 4,275 negative sequence frames. Verified by 6 senior gastroenterologists, the dataset includes pixel-level segmentation masks and bounding boxes covering wide variations in polyp morphology, flat lesions, and resection artifacts across different endoscopic camera systems.
